openQuestions: If settlement succeeds but the final HTTP response carrying both the paid resource and PAYMENT-RESPONSE is lost, what protocol-level recovery path lets the buyer reconcile fulfillment without making another payment?
Is replay of the same PAYMENT-SIGNATURE after a lost final response a defined recovery operation across every supported scheme/network pair, or is behavior scheme-specific?
What evidence should an autonomous buyer treat as canonical for resource delivery when financial settlement is independently known to have committed?
